title: Music City Lakeside Resort
description:
Discover a 7-bed, 3-bathroom lakefront home, minutes from downtown Nashville, offering relaxation and urban excitement. With a serene lakeside setting and easy access to city life.

The space
As you enter the house, you'll immediately notice the spacious, open floor plan with high ceilings, creating an airy and welcoming atmosphere.

The main floor features a  living room with TV, a dining area, and a modern kitchen. It has three bedrooms one with a queen with lake view, bedroom 2 with a  queen, and bedroom 3 with 2 queens.

The second floor has four bedrooms: one with a queen, one with 2 Queens and Lakeview with balcony, one with 1 queen + single over full bunk bed Lakeview and balcony, and one with 2 single over full bunk beds. 

The bottom floor is an entertainment area with a pool table, pingpong table, couches, and a TV for lounging. This floor also has access to a patio outside with beautiful views of the surrounding area.

Guest access
The entire home is accessible.

Other things to note
This property is conveniently located near waterparks, rock climbing, outdoor music venues, and many other exciting attractions. But when you're ready to relax and take in the breathtaking views, you can do so from one of the property's three large decks or by the burn pit outside. 

With so much to offer, this lakefront property is the perfect getaway for anyone looking to experience the best of both worlds - the tranquility of the lake and the excitement of downtown Nashville.
